summary.text: Austin Baeth is a Democratic state representative who has represented Iowa House District 36 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Baeth's career experience as a physician.

paragraphs.text: Austin Baeth was born in Des Moines, Iowa, according to Ballotpedia.
Baeth earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Iowa in 2007, a doctorate in medicine from the University of Iowa in 2012, and a graduate degree from the University of Colorado in 2015.
In the 2025-2026 session Baeth was assigned to the Economic Growth, House Government Oversight, House Human Resources, House Ways and Means and Health Policy Oversight committees.
